info.name: GoodDoc Emitter callback (gd-api)
info.description:
Act as the Emitter: push frames into an open plugin run in the panel.

1. Run `node dev.mjs` and open a plugin in the panel (Assistant stays open, so it's the easiest).
2. Send '1. Pick the newest run'. It sets runId, callbackUrl and seq.
3. Send any of the other requests. Each one is signed with callbackSecret and seq advances automatically.

If you get 409 seq_gap, seq was out of step (e.g. the mock sent frames too); it is fixed automatically, so send again.
410 = the run has ended: open a new one and repeat step 2.

For a real Emitter, take callback.url from gd-api's dispatch request instead of step 1, and use the real EMITTER_CALLBACK_SECRET.

Deployed gd-api (Cloudflare): use '1b' instead of '1'. It needs a dev-mode session and its sid; set apiUrl, sid and callbackSecret (the deployed EMITTER_CALLBACK_SECRET).

exec: // Signs every POST the way the Emitter must (contract: X-GD-Timestamp + X-GD-Signature).
// Resolve {{variables}} once, so the bytes we sign are exactly the bytes we send.
console.log('seq was out of step; it is now ' + (r.error.lastSeq + 1) + '. Send the request again.');
pm.test('run is still open (410: it has ended; open a new run and send step 1 again)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.equal(410));
pm.test('signature accepted (401: check callbackSecret matches EMITTER_CALLBACK_SECRET)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.equal(401));
// Picks the newest open run: sets {{runId}}, {{callbackUrl}} and {{seq}}.
pm.test('there is an open run (open a plugin in the panel first)', () => pm.expect(runs.length).to.be.above(0));
console.log('Using run ' + run.runId + ' (' + run.plugin + '), next seq ' + run.nextSeq);

request.description: Open a plugin in the panel first (Assistant is easiest: it stays open). This finds that run and sets runId, callbackUrl and seq.

item.name: 1b. Pick the newest run (deployed gd-api, dev mode)

exec: // Deployed gd-api: reads the dev-mode debug snapshot for {{sid}} and picks the newest open run.
pm.test('debug snapshot found (404: the session is not in dev mode, or sid is wrong)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200));
const runs = (snap.runs || []).filter((r) => r.status === 'open').sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
pm.test('there is an open run (open a plugin in the panel first)', () => pm.expect(runs.length).to.be.above(0));
console.log('Using run ' + runs[0].runId + ' (' + runs[0].plugin + '), next seq ' + (runs[0].lastSeq + 1));

request.description: For gd-api on Cloudflare (no mock Emitter). Needs a dev-mode session: a gd_test_ key initialised with devMode: true. Set {{apiUrl}} to your Worker URL and {{sid}} to the session id (shown in the panel's Dev view, or the ?sid= of its /v1/stream WebSocket). Set callbackSecret to the deployed EMITTER_CALLBACK_SECRET.
A complete assistant message in one frame.
Three frames in one request: two deltas, then the final text.
Shows a spinner line until the next message or UI.
Described UI: a card with key-values, a badge row and a button (the button sends ui.action to the Emitter).
A short notice in the panel.
Final frame: the panel shows the summary. Later frames for this run get 410.
Final frame: the panel shows the error card.
